cards.title: There is no database behind the extension
items: the extension's persistent state is chrome.storage; the remote system of record is the product API, reached over HTTPS with a host permission
storage.local: device-scoped settings, caches and the persisted job queue — not encrypted at rest
storage.session: the access token and ephemeral session state, in memory, visible to the worker and the extension's own pages

cards.title: The worker is the single writer
items: every durable write goes through a typed adapter with a schema, a version, a default and namespaced keys
read-modify-write runs under navigator.locks.request(key, …); another context asks the worker, it never writes directly
migrations are pure (vN) → (vN+1) functions, idempotent, run on install and lazily on first read, with a one-release backup key

cards.title: What may be stored where
items: a token never goes to storage.local, storage.sync or IndexedDB; storage.session is the extension's ephemeral store
storage.managed is read-only admin policy: the effective setting is managed > user (local/sync) > defaults, computed by a pure resolver
storage.onChanged on the managed area recomputes the policy and applies the kill switch immediately

cards.title: Outbound and inbound
items: the worker fetches the API with the bearer token, the tenant and the correlation headers attached by the SDK
a content script's fetch runs with the page's origin and the page's CORS rules; only the worker gets the host permission
the response returns as data to the UI; a token never crosses back to a surface or a page
